$comment: What the TypeScript language server changes on top of the grammar for the samples in this folder (semantic highlighting).
Each entry is [line, column, text, role, italic]: line from 1, column from 0, role as in src/variants/*.mjs.
Recorded with TypeScript 6.0.3 (the version bundled with VS Code) and the rules of the Serena themes: parameters are
recolored where they are used, a constant that holds a function takes the function color, and a class after "new"
takes the type color. When a sample changes, open it in VS Code with a Serena theme, compare with
"Developer: Inspect Editor Tokens and Scopes" and update the entries; render.mjs stops when an entry no longer matches the text.
